description: Migrating Classic Custom Buttons (Detail Page Buttons, List Buttons, Mass Action Buttons) and JavaScript Buttons to Lightning Quick Actions, Screen Flow Actions, LWC Quick Actions, and headless Quick Actions. Covers JavaScript-button-to-action translation patterns (sforce.apex.execute → Apex action, navigation alerts → toast events, MassAction.update → record-collection processing), URL button translation, and the WebLink inventory (displayType, linkType) that sizes the migration. NOT for new Quick Action design (use admin/global-actions-and-quick-actions) or Lightning record page composition (use admin/lightning-app-builder-advanced).
inputs: Inventory of Classic Custom Buttons by type (Detail Page, List, Mass Action) and content type (URL, OnClick JavaScript, Visualforce Page)
Per-button JavaScript content (for JS buttons) including AJAX calls, navigation, alerts, and Apex execution
Button placement (which page layouts, which list views)
User profiles allowed to invoke each button
Whether the button must work in Salesforce Mobile App (some patterns are mobile-only)
name: custom-button-to-action-migration
official_sources: WebLink fields (`displayType`, `linkType` values, `url` holds the JavaScript): api_meta 264 L47857-47860, L47926-47932, L47984-47986; the WebLink sObject supports `query()`: object_reference 264 L314753-314755
QuickAction `type` values (no URL value; Flow is Beta as of 41.0; LightningComponent 38.0+): api_meta 264 L102947-102971
S-controls deprecated since Spring '09: api_meta 264 L45109-45110; `Scontrol` type marked Deprecated: L109760-109761
LWC quick actions: record pages only, `actionType`, not supported in the mobile app: LWC guide `use-config-for-quick-actions`; headless `invoke()` and `recordId`: `use-quick-actions-headless`
`WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED` cannot be used at API 67.0 and later: apexdev 264 L11926-11927

Mass quick actions (an existing create or update action, Lightning Experience) and list-view buttons: api_meta 264 L47565-47572, L47523-47526. The `use-quick-actions-mass.html` page an earlier list cited returns 404 and is removed; a selection reaching Apex or a Flow is UNVERIFIED (2026-10-20)

The WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED SOQL Clause Is Removed (Summer '26 / API 67.0) — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=release-notes.rn_apex_removed_withSecurityEnforced.htm&type=5 — grounds the version qualifier on the Security pillar note above

Secure Apex Code with User Mode Database Operations (Generally Available) (Spring '23 / API 57.0) — https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=release-notes.rn_apex_User_Mode_GA.htm&type=5 — UNVERIFIED (2026-10-20): Help-only; the only source for the 57.0 floor
outputs: Lightning Quick Actions (object-specific) replacing Detail Page Buttons
Screen Flow Actions replacing JavaScript buttons that need user input or branching
LWC Quick Actions (headless or screen) replacing JS buttons that perform Apex calls
List-view actions backed by Apex/Flow replacing List and Mass buttons (the list-view surface is UNVERIFIED 2026-10-20, Help-only)
Audit log mapping each Classic button to its Lightning replacement (or 'retained for Classic only' status)
